Running Nvidia/China thread: the 11-08 card covered the NYT 'empty office' H200 licensee report; only a Commerce/BIS response, license revocation, congressional letter with a formal demand, or indictment is new. In scope: bills introduced/marked up, agency rules/bulletins, court rulings and filings, regulator enforcement, export-control actions, official post-election after-action reports on AI-enabled interference, platform takedown reports. OUT of scope: who won, seat counts, polling, horse-race analysis, 'AI was the big issue of the midterms' commentary. Neutrality rule from sources.json applies: report decisions/filings/releases, attribute contested claims, no partisan framing.
